summary.text: Carl DeMaio is a Republican who has represented California's 75th Assembly District, in San Diego, since 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to CalMatters, he was elected to the San Diego City Council in 2008, the first openly gay man elected to the council, and he founded the Reform California political action committee.
CalMatters also describes him as a podcast host who lives in San Diego with his husband.
